title: Hot tub & Pool table! 20 minutes to Nashville!
description:
Just 20 minutes from Nashville, this private basement Airbnb offers a spacious game room with a pool table, foosball, and darts. Step outside your door to unwind in the hot tub, or enjoy a night in with plenty of board games.  Full description ⬇️

The space
The Airbnb is located in the basement of our family home 🏠 You will enter through a private and separate door from the main house!  

MAXIMUM GUESTS
Maximum occupancy is 4 guests at all times. No parties or additional visitors allowed. Reservations exceeding 4 guests will be canceled.

LAYOUT
This space is one large open area with no separate bedrooms. It is a finished basement and works best for close-knit couples, families, or small groups who are comfortable sharing an open space.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS 
• Queen-size Murphy bed
• Large sectional couch
• Leather couch that folds down into a floor bed (best suited for one adult)

*As a house rule, we maintain a pet-free home*

Guest access
Guests have access to the basement, back patio, and backyard during their stay. The remainder of the home is private.

Other things to note
PLEASE CONSIDER: This is a family home with young children upstairs, so you will hear daytime noise from running and playing. Most guests don’t find it bothersome, but it’s something to keep in mind before booking if you’re looking for a completely quiet stay.
